name: Emergent Solar Energy
old_description: Your business deserves a trusted solar contractor who specializes in getting results for Indiana farms and manufacturers. Get in touch and let’s find a time to visit your site and make a plan together.
about:
Emergent Solar Energy is headquartered in West Lafayette, Indiana, within the Purdue Research Park. Founded in 2014, the company was established to provide best-in-class on-site solar power to manufacturing, agricultural, and large energy-load facilities. The leadership team includes Jeremy Lipinski, Adam Bolen, and Zacaria Martinez.

The firm operates as a full-service solar EPC contractor, delivering turnkey solar photovoltaic and battery energy storage systems under a single contract. Its integrated delivery model covers feasibility analysis, site-specific engineering with performance modeling, equipment procurement, construction management, utility interconnection, and commissioning. The company reports over 10 years of commercial and industrial project experience, with a documented 99.89% operational uptime across active facilities.

Emergent serves manufacturing, agricultural, municipal, institutional, and commercial clients throughout Indiana and neighboring states. Notable projects include a solar installation for Subaru of Indiana Automotive. The company focuses on facilities with complex energy loads, offering solutions that reduce operating costs, manage demand charges, and support sustainability goals.

The company emphasizes disciplined engineering, construction quality, and long-term asset performance. Its differentiation includes PE-engineered designs, component selection driven by warranty strength and supply-chain reliability, and a 25-year production warranty backed by a 5-year workmanship guarantee. The mission centers on fortifying Indiana businesses through energy independence and cost reduction.
